home.heroTitle: Blessing communities with the tools to thrive.
home.heroPhotoAlt: Hope For The Nations volunteers during a jornada
home.heroBody: We equip vulnerable children, families, and communities through education, jornadas of outreach, and sustainable programs — rooted in Christian compassion and carried out with local partners around the world.
home.beyondBody: Hope for the Nations began its work in Venezuela. As needs have grown, so has our reach — we now also support jornadas and programs in Central America and the United States, with more regions on the horizon as we continue to grow.
home.flagshipBody: Our own online high school, officially registered with the Florida Department of Education, delivering education to students worldwide — the centerpiece of our work today.
home.quote: “Grateful for every hand that showed up this weekend’s jornada in Trujillo. Thank you for making this possible.”

about.title: About Hope for the Nations
about.missionBody: We empower vulnerable children, families, and communities through education, economic opportunity, humanitarian assistance, and sustainable development initiatives.
about.visionBody: We envision a world where every child, family, and community has the opportunity to thrive through education, economic opportunity, and compassionate support.
about.journey2026: School of Hope International officially registered with the Florida Department of Education
about.heroPhotoAlt: Hope for the Nations volunteers after a jornada
about.whoBody1: Hope for the Nations is a 501(c)(3) nonprofit dedicated to empowering vulnerable communities through education, basic needs support, and life-changing opportunities. Founded with a vision to serve those often overlooked, we focus on helping children, youth, and families in South America, Central America, and immigrant populations in the U.S. gain access to education and essential resources.
about.whoBody2: Our initiatives, including the School of Hope Language Program, provide English and Spanish language instruction, educational materials, and technology access to students who otherwise would not have the opportunity to learn. Every program we implement is designed to inspire hope, build resilience, and create pathways for a brighter future.
about.whoBody3: We believe that every child deserves a chance to succeed — and with the support of our community, we make that vision a reality.
about.whoPhotoAlt: A team of Hope for the Nations volunteers
about.missionBody2: Working across South America, Central America, and the United States, we partner with local leaders and organizations to create pathways toward self-sufficiency, improved quality of life, and lasting community transformation.
about.missionBody3: Inspired by Christian values of compassion, service, and human dignity, we strive to help individuals realize their full potential and build brighter futures for generations to come.
about.visionBody2: We dream of strong and resilient communities where hope overcomes poverty, dignity replaces despair, and individuals are empowered to reach their God-given potential. Through sustainable solutions, meaningful partnerships, and faith in action, we seek to inspire lasting transformation for generations to come.
about.visionBody3: Guided by the love and principles of Christ, we envision communities united in building a brighter, more just, and hope-filled future.
about.beginningIntro: Hope for the Nations was born from the desperate situation the people of Venezuela are living through — an economic crisis so deep that it brought with it:
about.beginning4: a growing number of people eating from garbage dumps
about.beginning5: a great, unprecedented exile from this Latin American country
about.beginningPhotoAlt: Children sharing a meal during a Hope for the Nations jornada
about.timeline2018Body: Hope for the Nations was officially registered as a 501(c)(3) nonprofit organization in the state of Tennessee, marking the beginning of our mission-driven work to serve vulnerable communities through education, humanitarian assistance, and community development.
about.timelineFloridaBody: Hope for the Nations completed its nonprofit registration in the State of Florida, expanding its legal presence and operational reach.
about.timelineInfraBody: The organization invested in educational infrastructure, including the acquisition of a learning management platform to support accessible and scalable education programs.
about.timelineSohBody: School of Hope International was officially registered as an educational program under Hope for the Nations, a key milestone in the organization’s education-focused strategy.
about.timeline2026Body: School of Hope International was registered with the Florida Department of Education in February 2026 and is now working toward Cognia accreditation, as its educational programs begin.
about.quote: We plant the seed in them, and we hope this seed flourishes and gives back its fruits. All these projects aim to help people become sustainable, because we do not want to treat the problem — we are looking for long-term solutions.

team.title: Leadership & Team
team.intro: Behind every student, every family, and every program is a team of passionate individuals committed to making quality education and lasting hope accessible to all. At Hope for the Nations, we believe lasting impact is created when people with different talents come together with one shared purpose: transforming lives through education, compassion, and service.
team.boardBody: Our Board of Directors provides strategic leadership, governance, and accountability to ensure that Hope for the Nations remains faithful to its mission while pursuing sustainable growth and long-term impact.
team.boardComingSoon: Board members will be introduced here soon.
team.schoolBody: School of Hope International is Hope for the Nations' flagship education program — an online high school officially registered with the Florida Department of Education in February 2026. We are currently working toward Cognia accreditation over the next year. The school is led by a dedicated multidisciplinary team in academics, admissions, technology, and communications. More details about that team will be shared on School of Hope International's own site.
team.volunteersBody: Many of our programs are made possible through the dedication of volunteers who generously contribute their time, expertise, and hearts to serve others. Together, we are building opportunities that change lives.
team.cultureIntro: We believe that strong organizations are built on strong values. Everything we do is guided by our commitment to:
team.valueIntegrityBody: We act with honesty, transparency, and accountability.
team.valueCompassionBody: We serve others with empathy and respect.
team.valuePurposeBody: We are driven by a mission greater than ourselves.
team.valueExcellenceBody: We pursue quality in everything we do.
team.valueInnovationBody: We embrace creativity and technology to improve education.
team.valueFaithBody: We believe every person has God-given potential.
team.valueServiceBody: We lead by serving our students, families, and communities.
team.outreachIntro: Our volunteer team: the people who give their time and talent to make every jornada and program possible.
